This package contains the following policies:

## `network`

- cnp-ingress-best-practice-cassandra-server-restrict-access-over-internet

Deny exposure of Cassandra cluster on the public internet. Enforce Least Privilege

- cnp-ingress-cassandra-server-access-least-privilege

Allow only permitted requests to Cassandra server. Enforce Least Privilege
